title: fix(run): args after -- must not override dispatch --role
description:
## what

since rhachet 1.54.1, `rhx <skill> --repo R --role A -- --role B` resolves the skill under role B. args after `--` belong to the skill, yet rhachet reads them as its own flags.

## repro

```
rhx review.by --repo bhrain --role reviewer -- --role ghost
✋ ConstraintError: no skill "review.by" found with --repo bhrain --role ghost
[args] run,--skill,review.by,--repo,bhrain,--role,reviewer,--,--role,ghost
```

on 1.51.0 the same call ran `review.by` from role=reviewer and passed `--role ghost` to the skill.

## impact

- every role wrapper that forwards `-- --role <target>` (the review.by pattern) breaks
- ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhrain#855: `blackbox/review.by.dispatch.acceptance.test.ts` fails all 3 cases, the happy path included

## shape of the fix

- stop the dispatch parse at the first `--`; forward every arg after it to the skill as is
- clamp: an acceptance case with `--role A -- --role B` that asserts the skill resolves under A and receives `--role B`
